NOTE: This portion of the meeting is reserved for persons wishing to address the City Council on any matter not on the agenda. Persons wishing to address the Council are requested, but not required to complete a Speaker’s Card. Speakers are limited to two (2) minutes. The law generally prohibits the Council from discussion or taking action on such items. However, the Council may instruct staff accordingly regarding Oral Requests.

7.
CONSENT CALENDAR

 

NOTE: All matters listed under consent calendar are considered by the City Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a request is made by a member of City Council, City staff, or a member of the public. Any person wishing to speak on any item on the consent calendar should ask to have the item removed from the consent calendar prior to the time the Council votes to approve. If removed, the item will be discussed in the order in which it appears.

8.1
Public Hearing to consider recommendation of (1) an ordinance amending Chapter 21.24 (Inclusionary Housing Ordinance) and Chapter 21.14 (Overlay/Combining Districts) to facilitate housing development and clarify related regulatory requirements; and (2) an ordinance amending Chapter 21.20 (Density Bonuses and Other Housing Incentives) to implement Assembly Bill 1287 (2023) and establish a local density bonus incentive to encourage the production of small-scale "affordable by design" housing units in furtherance with the 2023–2031 Housing Element. Resolutions/Ordinances/Roll Call Vote)

 
1.Report for Public Hearing to consider recommendation of ordinances amending Chapter 21.24 (Inclusionary Housing Ordinance), Chapter 21.14 (Overlay and Combining Districts) and Chapter 21.20 (Density Bonuses) .pdf
2.Draft Ordinance (Chapter 21.20).pdf
3.Draft Ordinance (Chapters 21.24, 21.14).pdf
  • Recommended Action
    That the City Council take the following actions: (1) Take first reading, introducing an Ordinance amending Chapter 21.24 (Inclusionary Housing Ordinance) and Chapter 21.14 (Overlay/Combining Districts) and (2) Take first reading, introducing an Ordinance amending Chapter 21.20 (Density Bonuses and Other Housing Incentives).

9.1
Updates to Campbell Administrative Policy 2.8 - Insurance Claims Procedures (Resolution Roll Call Vote)

 
1.Report Updates to Campbell Administrative Policy 2.8 - Insurance Claims Procedures.pdf
2.Resolution Amending Administrative Policy 2.8 (Claims Procedures).pdf
3.2.8 Insurance Claims Procedures - JPA (Revised 11-18-25) REDLINE.pdf
4.2.8 Insurance Claims Procedures - JPA (Revised 11-18-25) CLEAN.pdf
  • Recommended Action

    That the City Council approve a resolution to amend Campbell Administrative Policy 2.8 (Insurance Claims Procedures) Section 7.F.2 regarding claims settlement authority levels to account for inflationary factors, improve operational efficiency, and align to best practice within similar municipalities, the City’s self-insured retention limit (SIR), and recent changes to the City Manager’s agreement award threshold, Section 7.B regarding delegation of authority to deny claims, and several other sections to clarify and bring current language where necessary.

  • Recommended Action
    That the City Council review and approve the proposed revisions to City Council Policy Section 10, including the relocation of specific provisions to newly established Sections 24 and 25, in order to enhance organization, improve clarity, and ensure greater policy consistency.
